title: Top sections
axis: navigation is horizontal: the six sections as a second nav bar with search in it, a slim left list of the current section's pages (with the open page's headings nested under it), one wide reading column with no right rail
worse_at: Never shows the whole tree on a docs page: a reader who does not know a page's section guesses a tab or searches, and only the /docs/ landing lists every page. Two stacked bars cost vertical space, and on the phone the section strip hides tabs 4 to 6. Six uneven labels and section sizes (nine DA pages, one FAQ page). The table of contents is cramped inside the 240 px list on long pages.
